histories.prompt: Wide POV shot from the front of a small aluminum flood rescue boat, slowly moving through muddy brown floodwater in a wooded area, overcast daylight, trees partially submerged in the background. In the distance ahead, two small squirrels are spotted clinging to the top of a wooden fence post surrounded by water, tails raised, looking frightened. The boat drifts steadily forward as the camera slowly approaches them, water rippling around the hull. Cinematic realistic documentary wildlife rescue style, natural handheld boat sway, no visible people, no dialogue.
